nota: Imagens da vídeo-aula 1A (diálogo da Ana e do Paulo na recepção), 21/11/2026.
estilo: Cinematic photographic film still for an English course video, shot on a cinema camera, natural soft morning light, realistic warm colour grading with deep navy blue and golden yellow accents of the office, true-to-life skin tones, shallow depth of field, calm and professional.
regras: Do not include any text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or captions anywhere in the image; screens are blurred or seen from the side. Contemporary Angola, 2026. Respectful, natural, non-stereotyped depiction of African professionals. No real people, no real brands. Every character from a reference sheet keeps exactly the same face, hair, body and clothes as in the sheet.

imagens.descricao: The same reception as the last reference image (navy blue wall with a golden yellow stripe, light wooden desk, plants), at eight in the morning. Ana from her reference sheet stands behind the reception desk; Paulo from his sheet has just arrived in front of the desk, holding a laptop bag on his shoulder. They greet each other politely with calm, friendly smiles, looking at each other, as on a first day at work, mouths closed or slightly open as if talking. Medium-wide shot from the side of the desk, both faces clearly visible, natural and relaxed, not excited.
